clusters.description: Topuria's first post since the Gaethje loss: an emotional video/letter to his son Hugo about losing and getting back up (Friday 4 Sep)
clusters.doubt: 682's body is Yahoo boilerplate with no article text; placed here on date (4 Sep) and headline only.

clusters.description: Topuria publishes a long 9-part essay ('This Is Me' / exclusive for Marca, Saturday 5 Sep) about his childhood, the loss, his broken face and wanting to return without erasing the defeat
clusters.doubt: Published one day after the Hugo video and several outlets (755, 875, 728) cover both; 728 attributes the essay quotes to Instagram, 875's visible body mostly recaps the Hugo letter while its headline is an essay quote.

clusters.description: Jon Anik (Anik Bros YouTube) says UFC is having internal conversations about an immediate Gaethje vs Topuria rematch
clusters.doubt: 798's body is boilerplate and says 'according to reports' without naming Anik, but date and framing match.

clusters.description: Paddy Pimblett (Eze Talks Sports interview at McCann's Dublin bout) says nobody has contacted him about a December Topuria fight, lists Arman/Gaethje/Ruffy/Oliveira as options
clusters.doubt: 843's body is boilerplate; assigned by headline, date and the Dublin ringside photo caption. 838 also reports Anik's rematch remarks in its second half.

clusters.description: Molly McCann says Pimblett will win a UFC belt in 2027, same year she wins a boxing title (about McCann/Pimblett, Topuria only mentioned)
RAF Moscow (Chimaev vs Woodley) loses its US streaming option on Fox Nation; Topuria appears only in a 'latest news' link
OkDiario interview with Fran Ortega, Topuria's physiotherapist, on recovery and rest
Michael 'Venom' Page puts on another dull decision at UFC Paris after promising to take risks (no Topuria content at all)

uncertain_pairs.why: 755 gives roughly equal space to the Hugo video and the essay; it could belong with the video cluster instead of the essay cluster.
728 quotes essay lines ('defeat did not extinguish the fire') but attributes them to Instagram and opens with the Hugo post, so it may really be a Hugo-video article.
875's headline is the essay's parents/promise quote but its visible body is a recap of the Hugo letter plus older quotes.
Video to Hugo (Friday) and essay (Saturday) are one day apart, same theme, same author; a reviewer could argue they are one 'Topuria breaks silence' story.
682's body is Yahoo boilerplate; 'breaks silence with emotional message' could describe the essay rather than the Hugo video.
838 is a Pimblett interview piece but its second half reports Anik's rematch comments; it touches both stories.
843's body is boilerplate, so it was matched to the Pimblett Dublin interview on headline and photo caption alone.
